challenge.method: I compared the first paragraph of §3.5 with its next paragraph and the later formal tail-context definitions on the same printed page.
challenge.results: A tail call derives from its defined syntactic context. Activity means the callee might still return, including through a previously captured continuation if invoked. The case with no captured continuations is a special case.

limitations: The claim records the report’s control rule. Arbitrary resource bounds and tail positions beyond the report’s grammar require separate analysis.
